result.title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
result.summary: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8-4.0x faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86-92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GUI-JEPA：以预训练 JEPA 编码 GUI 截图，用动作与区域条件化的潜变量预测器为每个候选动作生成潜表示，再由轻量头批量打分，实现无需逐 token 解码的移动端操作选择，并分析潜通路依赖与预测器预训练的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 中视觉细节是否保留在内部状态、决策是否真正使用 latent 内容及推理成本直接相关；其「随机初始化预测器与预训练效果相当」的发现可供核查潜状态训练信号与贡献分配，但任务限于候选动作打分而非多步 latent 推理。
